title: 새벽 4시 세탁기
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Funk-Pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated 16th-note muted scratches and staccato chords. A slap bass guitar performs a busy, percussive line with frequent slides and pops. The drum kit features a crisp snare and a tight, dry kick drum. Bright, staccato brass stabs from a trumpet and saxophone section punctuate the transitions. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, melodic style with occasional falsetto leaps. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E Major. Synthesizer pads provide subtle harmonic sustain in the background.
